name: Jitters' Growling Gut
label: Quest
description: Stranded and terrified in the ruins of Raven Hill, the paranoid vagrant Jitters is desperate for real sustenance after subsisting on weeds and insects.…
intro: Stranded and terrified in the ruins of Raven Hill, the paranoid vagrant Jitters is desperate for real sustenance after subsisting on weeds and insects. He begs passing adventurers to travel east to Darkshire and convince Chef Grual to prepare a hot batch of his famous Dusky Crab Cakes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds! I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.
Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.
I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good :Dusky Crab Cakes...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need some Crab Cakes, do you? Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
